en.title: Montenegro: up to 31 cm of new snow on the way, most of it on Thursday 26 November
en.description: Montenegro's mountains could see 31 cm of snow in the week ahead, with 24 cm forecast for Thursday 26 November. Data from 20 November.
en.lede: Montenegro is about to change. After a dry spell, snow is moving in fast: 390 km² of high ground turned white between 19 and 20 November alone. The week ahead could bring up to 31 cm to the highest slopes, with Thursday 26 November shaping up as the heaviest day at 24 cm.

p: The pattern shift is already underway. Between yesterday and today, almost 380 km² of mountainside switched from bare to snow-covered. This rapid change marks the start of a wetter spell.

Over the next seven days, up to 31 cm is forecast across the snowiest terrain. The next three days will bring 8 cm, with the main event arriving on Thursday 26 November: a single day could dump 24 cm in the highest zones. After that, the pace eases but snow will continue through the weekend.

Snow now covers roughly 3 % of Montenegro's mapped peaks and ridges, climbing steeply from yesterday's trace. The snow line sits near 2,100 m. Above 2,000 m, the depth averages 2 cm and covers about 55 % of the terrain; between 1,500 and 2,000 m, cover drops to 13 % with almost no measurable depth yet.

This means early-season snow is thin and patchy. Grass and bare rock show through the cover above 2,000 m; below 1,500 m, slopes remain almost entirely bare. Groomed runs at the resort will be your safest bet.

Three hotspots stand out. The Prokletije, the high barrier range to the north, has picked up 7 cm in the past three days and leads the country. Durmitor to the west has 5 cm over the same period. Bjelasica in the south trails with 4 cm but sits in the path of the incoming system.

Ski centar Savin kuk, the only resort currently tracking snow, holds 6 cm on its upper slopes and has collected 5 cm over three days. By Monday 23 November, another 20 cm is expected there, making it the focus for the coming week.

sections.h: How this week compares with the past week
p: The turnaround is stark. Last week Montenegro saw barely any snow spread; white cover stayed between 10 and 80 km², with no growth pattern. Ski centar Savin kuk held the deepest snow every day, but depths were falling. The trend reversed sharply on 20 November.

A week ago, 200 km² was white; today that figure has doubled to 390 km². This is not a stable snow season yet, but the trajectory is now favourable for the resorts that depend on natural accumulation.

Bosnia and Herzegovina, to the west, remains almost bare at 0 % white cover, with no meaningful snow on its resorts yet. However, it too could see up to 30 cm in the week ahead. Albania, to the south, has 3 % cover but no depth at its main resort; it may collect up to 24 cm by week's end.
Montenegro sits between these two and could emerge as the week's snow leader in the region, especially if Thursday's forecast holds.

Early-season snow bonds poorly to cold, bare ground. Fresh flakes on a frozen base can slide on steep terrain, so stay alert and ski slopes well within your comfort zone. Take the groomed runs first; they will be tracked and safer than untracked high terrain.

Morning light after a clear night hardens the surface on south-facing slopes, making them firm and sometimes icy. Wait for midday sun to soften them before committing to steep pitches. By contrast, north-facing slopes will stay cold and slower. Rocks and grass still poke through above 2,000 m, so watch your line and avoid the thinnest patches.

advice: Target Ski centar Savin kuk from Friday onwards; by then it will have collected most of the week's incoming snow and offer the deepest cover in the country.
Stick to groomed terrain and marked runs. Untracked snow is thin and hides obstacles; early-season off-piste is not ready. Check the official avalanche bulletin before any steeper venture.

Bring layers for a quick change: Thursday will be snowy and cool; the following days may turn milder. Plan flexible timing and check the forecast again on Tuesday 24 November before committing to a trip.
Sunrise on 27 November may offer the best visibility and corn snow on south faces if the forecast holds; plan for that if you can.
Because snow cover above 1,500 m is still patchy and irregular, stay on-piste and avoid the margins where grass meets snow.

captions.map: Snow cover across Montenegro on 20 November. White patches mark terrain above 1,500 m; the heaviest cover (55 %) lies between 2,000 and 2,500 m near the snow line at 2,100 m.
captions.story: The snow system moving into Montenegro will peak on Thursday 26 November with up to 24 cm in the highest zones. Data valid 20 November.

cnr.title: Snijeg u Crnoj Gori danas: visina snježnog pokrivača i novi snijeg, 20. novembra 2026.
cnr.description: Planine Crne Gore mogu vidjeti 31 cm snijega u narednoj sedmici, s prognozom od 24 cm za četvrtak 26. novembra. Podaci od 20. novembra.
cnr.lede: Crna Gora se spremala za promjenu. Poslije suhe periode, snijeg dolazi brzo: 390 km² visokih terena postalo je bijelo između 19. i 20. novembra. Naredna sedmica može donijeti do 31 cm na najviše padine, a četvrtak 26. novembra se oblikuje kao najtežnji dan s 24 cm.

p: Promjena uzorka je već u toku. Između juče i danas, gotovo 380 km² planinskog terena prešlo je s golih na snježne površine. Ova brza promjena označava početak vlažnije periode.

Tijekom sljedećih sedam dana, do 31 cm je prognoziran na najsnježnijem terenu. Sljedeća tri dana donose 8 cm, a glavni događaj stiže četvrtka 26. novembra: jedan dan može donijeti 24 cm u najvišim zonama. Poslije toga, tempo se usporava ali će snijeg nastaviti kroz vikend.

Snijeg sada pokriva otprilike 3% od mapiranih vrhova i grebena Crne Gore, oštro raste od jučerašnjih tragova. Granica snijega je blizu 2.100 m. Iznad 2.000 m, prosječna dubina je 2 cm i pokriva oko 55% terena; između 1.500 i 2.000 m, pokrivač pada na 13% bez gotovo nikakve izmjerljive dubine još.

To znači da je rani sezonski snijeg tanak i flekeast. Trava i gola stijena vidljive su kroz pokrivač iznad 2.000 m; ispod 1.500 m, padine ostaju gotovo potpuno gole. Uređene piste na skijalištu bit će vam najsigurnija opcija.

Tri žarišne točke se ističu. Prokletije, visok barijerski lanac na sjeveru, prikupila je 7 cm u posljednja tri dana i vodi zemlju. Durmitor na zapadu ima 5 cm u istom periodu. Bjelasica na jugu zaostaje s 4 cm ali se nalazi na putu dolazeće sisteme.

Ski centar Savin kuk, jedino skijaće koje trenutno prati snijeg, drži 6 cm na svojim gornjim padinama i prikupila je 5 cm tijekom tri dana. Do ponedjeljka 23. novembra, očekuje se dodatnih 20 cm tamo, čineći ga fokusom za narednu sedmicu.

sections.h: Kako se ova sedmica brani s prošlom sedmicom
p: Obrat je ozbiljan. Prošle sedmice Crna Gora je vidjela gotovo nijedan snježni raspored; bijeli pokrivač je ostao između 10 i 80 km², bez obrazca rasta. Ski centar Savin kuk je držao najdublji snijeg svakog dana, ali su dubine padale. Trend se oštro okrenuo 20. novembra.
Prije tjedna, 200 km² je bilo bijelo; danas je taj broj udvostručen na 390 km². Ovo nije još stabilna snježna sezona, ali putanja je sada povoljna za skijaće koje ovise o prirodnoj akumulaciji.

Bosna i Hercegovina, na zapadu, ostaje gotovo gola s 0% bijelog pokrivača, bez značajnog snijega na svojim skijalištima još. Međutim, i ona može vidjeti do 30 cm u narednoj sedmici. Albanija, na jugu, ima 3% pokrivač ali nema dubine na svojem glavnom skijalištu; može prikupiti do 24 cm do kraja sedmice.
Crna Gora se nalazi između ove dvije i mogla bi izaći kao snježni vođa sedmice u regiji, posebno ako se četvrtkova prognoza drži.

Rani sezonski snijeg se slabo veže na hladnom, golom zemljištu. Svježe pahulje na smrznutoj bazi mogu kliziti na strmom terenu, pa budite oprezni i skirajte padine dobro unutar vaše zone udobnosti. Prvo uzmite uređene piste; biti će pratirane i sigurnije nego nepratirani visoki teren.

Jutarnje svjetlo nakon jasne noći stvrdnute površinu na južnim padinama, čineći ih čvrstima i ponekad ledenim. Čekajte podnevno sunce da ih mekan prije nego se obavežete na strmim nagibima. Nasuprot tome, sjeverne padine će ostati hladne i sporije. Stijene i trava jos uvijek strše iznad 2.000 m, pa pazite na vašu liniju i izbjegavajte najtan patch.

advice: Targirajte Ski centar Savin kuk od petka nadalje; do tada će prikupiti većinu snijega naredne sedmice i ponuditi najveću dubinu u zemlji.
Držite se uređenog terena i označenih pista. Nepraćeni snijeg je tanak i krije prepreke; rani sezonski van-piste nije spreman. Provjerite službeni buletin lavine prije bilo koje strmije avanture.

Nosi slojeve za brzu promjenu: četvrtak će biti snježan i hladan; sljedeći dani mogu biti blaži. Planirajte fleksibilno vrijeme i ponovno provjerite prognozu u utorak 24. novembra prije nego se obavežete na putovanje.
Izlazak sunca 27. novembra može ponuditi najbolju vidljivost i kukuruzni snijeg na južnim licima ako se prognoza drži; planirajte to ako možete.
Jer je snježni pokrivač iznad 1.500 m još flekeasta i nepravilna, ostanite on-piste i izbjegavajte rubove gdje trava susreće snijeg.
